conviction_note: No analyst consensus, no 月次, no revision or returns precedent at a Nikke Q3 print in four years. That leaves a small positive lean from an easy prior-year Q3 comparison (Q3 FY2025 OP fell 12%, and it had no Kako Technos and no full Yaesu building), partly offset by a revenue plan that implies H2 +15.7%. abs_move 2.0 sits near the 1.91 proxy because the stock's own Q3 reactions were small (+1.6, +0.6, -0.9 open-to-next-close), and p_up 55 is a proxy-level lean. Findings sum +0.3 against a scaled +0.2; the two agree.
bar: Company plan, unchanged since 2026-01-15 and reaffirmed 2026-07-15: FY11/2026 sales 130,000 / OP 13,000 / ordinary 13,400 / NP 9,500 (JPY m), dividend 50. Source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260615570502.pdf. No sell-side consensus exists: kabuyoho shows 0 analysts and no コンセンサス (https://kabuyoho.jp/reportTarget?bcode=3201), and I found no 四季報 number, so the bar is the plan read against Nikke's OWN 9-month progress rate. Operating profit through 9M ran 64.4% of the full year in FY2025 and 67.0% in FY2024. print_vs_bar is my estimated Q3 OP (~3,000m) against the ~2,925m that a 65.5% progress rate implies. Revenue will likely look weak against the plan (9M ~89-90bn against the ~95bn a 73% rate implies). The bar is the company's own plan, sourced but not a market number, so every size is kept small.

findings.finding: Q3 (Jun-Aug) faces an easy comparison: Q3 FY2025 OP was 2,750m (-12% yoy against 3,126m), with clothing hit by the school-uniform inventory glut. FY2026 adds Kako Technos (consolidated from Q1, not in the prior-year quarter) and the full-year contribution of the Yaesu-dori Filterrace office building. H1 ran OP +13.6% and Mar-May OP +22.3%. So the kabutan-style headline on the 9M figures is likely double-digit ordinary-profit growth with 9M OP progress of about 66-67%, in line with or ahead of the company's own 64-67% history.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 prints, sealed-spot proxy (open) to next close: 2023-10-13 +1.57, 2024-10-11 +0.55 (headline: 3Q経常 +14%, 6-8月期 +30%), 2025-10-10 -0.94 (headline: 3Q経常 +4%). The H1 FY2026 print, headlined 上期経常 +13% and 3-5月期 +18%, went +1.07 open-to-next and +3.45 close-to-next (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.why_not_priced: No analyst covers the name (kabuyoho shows 0 analysts), so nobody publishes a Q3 estimate. Getting to the easy comparison takes the prior-year Q3 segment table, worked out by subtracting H1 from 9M. If it were priced, the 20-day run-up would not be -2.3%. It is an inference from public filings, though, and today's +2% pre-print move may already hold part of it, so it is sized well under the scale.
findings.independence: The prior-year Q3 tanshin (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251010/140120251003568180.pdf) gives the 9M FY2025 segment profits from which the weak Q3 FY2025 is derived. The Q2 presentation (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260715/140120260615570483.pdf) raised the industrial OP plan to 3,200 and called Kako Technos PMI on plan. All are company documents, so the independence is weak.

findings.finding: The 130,000m revenue plan, held at Q2 by segment (industrial 43,000, clothing 34,000), implies H2 revenue of 70,290m against 60,765m last year (+15.7%). That includes industrial H2 +33% and clothing H2 +23% while the school-uniform glut persists ('2026年度にも影響'). The revenue line is therefore likely to stay visibly behind the plan at 9M, and a revenue-only trim could come with this release. Nikke has not revised at a Q3 print in the last four years.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Its forecast revisions: 2025-07-11 Q2 profit cut (school uniforms) went -6.20 open-to-next. 2025-11-21 dividend raise plus cancellation went +6.90. No revision at a Q3 print in FY2022-FY2025 (kabutan 修正履歴).
findings.why_not_priced: Anyone with the last tanshin can compute the revenue gap, so it is mostly public. What is not priced is whether the company trims revenue at this print. Its record says it will not, which is why this is small. If the market feared a cut, the stock would not have risen 2% into the release on a down day.
findings.independence: kabutan's revision history (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=3201) shows the plan unchanged since 26/01/15 and no Q3-print revisions in prior years. It shares the plan figures with the finding's own source.

outside_window.finding: Ordinary profit is running ahead: an estimated 9M progress of about 72% against 66-69% in the two prior years, with the plan implying H2 ordinary -3.5% while OP rises 6%. Treasury stock is 12.3% of issued shares. Last year Nikke announced the beat-side actions separately in late November (2025-11-21: dividend +5 yen and cancellation of 2.62% of shares, +6.9% open-to-next), and its buybacks were announced with full-year results in January. Any upward revision, dividend raise or cancellation therefore most likely lands after this window.

Any 四季報 / IFIS consensus for 3201: kabuyoho shows 0 analysts and no consensus; the WebSearch returned no 四季報 number
月次: Nikke publishes no monthly sales

Q3-print precedent for capital returns or revisions: none at the 2024-10-11 or 2025-10-10 prints. The 2025-10-10 ToSTNeT-3 executed an existing May 2025 program
release_time_source: Not confirmed for today. Inferred from the stamps of the last three prints on kabutan (2026-01-15, 2026-04-10, 2026-07-15 all 15:00), https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3201. The Q3 FY2025 print was stamped 15:30 (2025-10-10), so there is a small risk it releases at the close.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision at this print: unlikely (none at a Q3 print in four years); at most a revenue trim. Returns: none expected at Q3 by precedent; the November cancellation and dividend raise is outside the window. New-year guide: no, it is Q3. Quarter against its own 進捗率: OP likely about 66-67% against 64-67% history, and ordinary about 72% against 66-69%, i.e. in line to ahead; revenue behind.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Upward ordinary/NP revision plus dividend raise and share cancellation, by analogy with 2025-11-21
rejected_candidates.detail: Precedent timing is late November, after the 2026-10-13 exit; filed in outside_window

baseline_tension: Mildly positive against a neutral baseline: the lean is -0.02, there are no disclosed shorts, the 信用倍率 is 1.91 and the 20-day run-up is -2.3%. The +2% move before the seal on a down Nikkei day may already hold part of the easy-comp positive. The strongest positive the release could carry is an ordinary/NP upgrade or returns; I looked for both, and the company's precedent puts them in November, not at this print.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on a public progress rate moves p_up toward 50) applies to the -0.3 revenue finding, which was already sized small because a cut at this print is unlikely, and p_up already leans positive. Rule 2 (negatives outnumbering positives) does not bite, because one of two findings is negative and the strongest positive was looked for and placed outside the window.
